privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: First gap review against the domain map
goal: The next gap review reads docs/DOMAINS.md and reports extraction candidates and page corrections
acceptance: The review lists each shared domain whose Has column names two projects as an extraction candidate (Telemetry and Blackbox today: openbando and nerv), with the owning repository, or says why not
Corrections to the page found on the review are made in the same PR
F-013 closes when the review is recorded

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: compare two Blackbox readers and re-read the page. Not a measurement.
